Revoke a recipient and re-encrypt the vault without its key.

--reencrypt is required: without it the removed key still opens every entry
that already exists, so the revocation would only look like one. Removing
this device's own key is allowed but asks first, and removing the last
recipient is refused outright.

Usage:
  gage recipient remove [OPTIONS] <pubkey-or-name>

Arguments:
  <pubkey-or-name>  

Options:
      --reencrypt   re-encrypt every entry to the reduced recipient list (required)
  -u, --use <NAME>  vault to operate on (default: the current vault)
  -h, --help        Print help
